About Us
The famous Hotel/Restaurant Surselva is located in Welschdörfli, the beautiful town of Chur.
People from near and far meet in the cozy Dampfschiff restaurant with outdoor seating. Attached to it is the smoke-free D rflibar, which is open on weekends and offers young and old visitors a wide variety of entertainment. A few hotel rooms complete the offer. The well-known low prices are a hallmark of this venerable establishment.
On the 1st floor there is a newly renovated bar with a quiet atmosphere that leaves nothing to be desired.
We warmly welcome all guests and look forward to seeing you.
Our offers
Here you can choose
​ Hotel Surselva
Simple, comfortable hotel in the center of Chur. Single and double rooms available (without breakfast), parking spaces available.
Restaurant Dampfschiff
In our smoking restaurant Dampfschiff there is a family atmosphere, the lowest drink prices in Chur, young and old guests are warmly welcome.
Vulcano Bar / Dörfli Bar
Our bars allow you to sit comfortably in a modern environment. Thanks to the expanded selection in our drinks menu, you will never be bored.
